title: hc0n Christmas CTF
summary: A long-form challenge chaining web enumeration, CBC padding-oracle abuse, credential discovery, binary analysis, and buffer overflow exploitation.

title: Agent P
summary: A multi-stage chain moves from WordPress SQL injection through database credentials, unsafe pickle loading, and a signed-task binary to root.

title: Lost Fortune Included
summary: A PHP stream-wrapper bypass defeats the document whitelist and reads arbitrary files from the server.

title: B1t Recovery
summary: Known plaintext from the THM flag prefix recovers a reused four-byte XOR key and decrypts the challenge file.

title: Casino Heist
summary: Packet-capture analysis and PyInstaller reverse engineering recover the key used to decrypt exfiltrated jackpot data.

title: Fresh Powder
summary: A detection-as-code investigation repairs five broken Sigma rules and validates each fix against the incident report.

title: Beach Bar
summary: Leaked credentials lead to unsafe YAML deserialization, remote code execution, and Linux privilege escalation.

title: Do Not Disturb
summary: A NoSQL authentication bypass opens an EJS SSTI path, followed by debugger hijacking and privilege escalation.

title: Hollow Shell
summary: Default credentials and a Zip Slip upload escape the theme directory and turn an automation hook into code execution.

title: Infinity Pool
summary: Command injection in a legacy network-check endpoint leads through internal services to full compromise.

title: Room 404
summary: An exposed .git directory leaks the staging source and a flag left in the repository.

title: The Guestbook
summary: Prompt injection against an AI concierge reveals hidden directives and bypasses output redaction.

title: Towel on the Sunbed
summary: A race condition lets parallel reward claims bypass the 24-hour lock and open the Whale Vault.

title: Eavesdropper
summary: SSH access as Frank and process monitoring with pspy reveal credentials used for root privilege escalation.

title: Umbrella
summary: An exposed Docker registry leaks database credentials, leading through cracked hashes, command injection, and a privileged container to root.

title: Cupid’s Matchmaker
summary: Stored XSS in a matchmaking survey steals the reviewer’s session cookie and exposes the flag.

title: Corp Website
summary: CVE-2025-55182 provides remote code execution before a permissive sudo path completes privilege escalation.

title: CupidBot
summary: The bot leaks its verification code, which can be replayed to authorize disclosure of all three challenge flags.

title: Speed Chatting
summary: An unrestricted profile-image upload accepts executable Python and turns a chat account into a reverse shell.

title: TryHeartMe
summary: An improperly protected JWT lets a normal shopper forge an admin role and redeem the staff-only flag.

title: When Hearts Collide
summary: A broken MD5-based image matcher can be defeated with a collision to force a successful match.

title: Love Letter Locker
summary: An insecure direct object reference exposes another user’s private letter—and the flag—by changing its numeric ID.
